_doc: Phase-0 accuracy-gate targets: LESS paper Pythia rows + our reproduction (protocol step 5). Paper numbers are TyDiQA-only (Table 12, App. D.5: Pythia experiments were run for TyDiQA with ONE seed; the paper reports no Pythia MMLU/BBH rows). Our runs: fine-tune seed 0 unless suffixed; selection fraction 0.05; eval = LESS's bundled open-instruct scripts.

paper.source: Xia et al., LESS (ICML 2024), Table 12 - TyDiQA-GoldP dev F1, single seed
paper.note: No MMLU/BBH Pythia rows exist in the paper; those cells cannot be gated against it.

gate_verdict.ordering: REPRODUCED - LESS > Random > no-FT on TyDiQA, same as paper (9.4 > 7.8 > 3.8)
gate_verdict.absolute: LESS +2.2 pts, Random +3.0 pts vs the single-seed paper row (outside the +/-1-2 tolerance, in the same direction)
hypotheses: paper is single-seed without std; Llama-2 std on these metrics is 0.4-1.7
paper fine-tune/warmup seed likely 3 (repo job names use seed3); see SEED=3 rerun
our warmup checkpoint schedule differs by necessity: measured epoch-end {423,846,1269,1692}, uniform weights (docs/llm_vendor_patches.md)
gate_verdict.mmlu_bbh: random > less at 410M on two of three tasks; no paper reference exists for these cells at 410M (the paper's headline results are Llama-2/Mistral). Recorded, not gated.
